info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Contact Routing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Contact Routing Decision API facilitates the retrieval of contact routing decisions based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows businesses to effectively direct customer inquiries to the appropriate channels or agents by utilizing the provided 'param1'. Typical consumers of this API include customer service applications and support systems aiming to enhance response times and improve customer satisfaction. By leveraging this functionality, organizations can ensure efficient communication and service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve routing decision for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the routing decision for the resource identified by 'RES-100045'. It provides crucial information about how contact routing is handled for this resource.
